name: FlashAttention-4: Algorithm and Kernel Pipelining for Efficient Attention on Blackwell GPUs
notes: FA-4 paper. Key claims: up to 1605 TFLOPs/s BF16 on B200 (71% utilization), 1.3x vs cuDNN 9.13, 2.7x vs Triton. Backward bound by shared-memory bandwidth not FLOPs. Uses tcgen05 UMMA with TMEM accumulators, 2-CTA MMA, emulated exponential (Cody-Waite + Horner polynomial on FMA units). Written in CuTeDSL, optimized for Hopper and Blackwell.
